channel.title: Chima Ukachukwu: Writing
channel.description: Notes on AI security, SOC operations, and the bridge between them.

item.title: The Defence That Can't See the Attack
item.description: I built a prompt injection sandbox with no model in it. The most useful thing it does is show you a control failing for a reason that has nothing to do with how good the control is.

item.title: Taxonomies That Outlive the Exploit
item.description: Every jailbreak list I bookmarked in 2024 is now useless. The categories underneath them are not. Sorting attacks by mechanism instead of by phrasing is the difference between a framework and a changelog.

item.title: Detecting Prompt Injection: The Playbook Your SIEM Doesn't Have Yet
item.description: Prompt injection is succeeding in production right now, and most SOCs can't see it. Why traditional detection primitives partially-fail, three places where they can work, and what's still hard.

item.title: The Bridge: Why AI Security Needs SOC People, and SOC Needs AI Red Teamers
item.description: Two communities that should be talking to each other are mostly not. Here's what each side is missing, and what bridging them looks like in practice.
